newsitem.title: USA: Toyota 1998 Tacoma to start at $12,538.
newsitem.headline: Toyota 1998 Tacoma to start at $12,538.

text.p: The Toyota Division of Toyota Motor Sales U.S.A. Inc said Monday its updated Tacoma compact pickup truck will be priced starting at $12,538 for the 1998 model year, up $300, or 2.5 percent, from the previous model.
Toyota Motor Sales is a division of Toyota Motor Corp.
The $12,538 price is for the four-cylinder regular cab model equipped with a five-speed transmission, Toyota said.

Four-wheel drive models start at $17,428, up 1.8 percent or $300. The average manufacturer's suggested retail price increase for the updated 1998 Tacoma is 2.1 percent, or $350 over final 1997-model pricing, the company said.
All 1998 Tacoma models will be equipped with a standard passenger-side airbag with a cutoff switch, Toyota said.

The new Tacoma will feature extensive exterior appearance changes, including a restyled grille for four-wheel drive models, a larger front bumper, updated exterior paint colors and available overfenders, Toyota said. Inside, the Tacoma adds new rotary-type heating and ventilation controls, two additional power outlets and larger, more conveniently-placed cupholders.
